summary: Backend + Frontend testing of Policy Department-wise Applicability feature. Wrote 12-test pytest file (all pass); Playwright UI verified admin editor works end-to-end (radios, chips, Save enable/disable, persist across reload, employee cannot see editor). All mutations restored — policy_leave is back to applicability_mode=null, applicable_departments=[].
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >20k lines — long-term should be split into modules (policies, acknowledgements, etc.).

update_policy is generic (accepts arbitrary dict) — consider a Pydantic model to prevent accidental writes of unrelated fields via the same admin endpoint; currently protected only by role, no field allowlist.
Login field returns 'token' (not 'access_token'); consistent across code and tests — fine but worth noting for external consumers.
test_credentials: admin/HrAdmin@2109 (admin), user/pass123 (employee). madhan.s/Vigil@123 has drifted — invalid at test time; used 'user' instead for employee flows.
seed_data_creation: None. All modifications to policy_leave restored to original (applicability_mode=null, applicable_departments=[]).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend responds slowly (~30-45s first request; Cloudflare 502 while reloading). Use timeout>=120s. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_policy_applicability.py includes autouse teardown to restore policy_leave. Admin login returns key 'token'. Employee 'user' has restricted employee-portal menu (no Policies page in nav) so employee visibility of /policies UI cannot be exhaustively verified via UI — verified via backend GET /api/policies as employee token instead (test_employee_visibility_selected).
verified_behaviors: Eligible-employee summary count narrows when mode goes all → selected(single dept).
Backward-compat: policy_it (GLOBAL_POLICIES) visible to employees when mode=null.
Employee sees selected-mode policy iff their department matches; excluded otherwise.
Ack history preserved: after all→selected(other dept)→all, ack count returns to original (>= before).
Admin UI editor: radios, dept chips, Save disabled until changed, Save persists across reload.
Employee (non-admin) does not see any policy-applicability-* editor node.
